verdict.rationale: Warp's docs say its visual appearance can be customized, including fonts (warp-docs-90), so basic font selection is a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows the specific elements the story asks for. Missing for 10: ligature support, fallback font configuration, fine-grained font tuning (size, line height, weight, etc.), in-depth font docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
